svg.title: Gateway usage, Oct 7 to Nov 12, 2026, in full detail
svg.desc: Full-detail chart of T3 Fleet Gateway usage from October 7 to November 12, 2026. Two stacked bars with different totals. All events, 8,461: Grok Bot jobs 5,754 (68.0%), Minions/Botons 1,614 (19.1%), adopted/standing 946 (11.2%), other/test 147 (1.7%); a bracket marks the outer loop, Grok Bot plus Minions/Botons, 7,368 events or 87.1%. Jobs started or tracked, 376 (366 launched by the gateway plus 10 adopted/standing threads it tracks): Grok Bot 293 (77.9%), Minions/Botons 61 (16.2%), adopted/standing 10 (2.7%), other/test 12 (3.2%). Notes: events are gateway ledger records, not completed tasks, and leave out work done in T3 outside the gateway; events and jobs count toward the client that started the job; Grok Bot is every bot on the shared connector; Minions/Botons is another gateway client used in the Minions projects since November 5, where Botons is being built; adopted jobs can also be driven by outer-loop systems; other/test is early pilots, QA and one-offs. Snapshot November 12, 2026, about 8:50 AM PT.
svg.text: Jobs started by Grok Bot and Minions/Botons account for 7,368 events, or 87%. Oct 7 – Nov 12, 2026.
376 jobs = 366 launched by the gateway + 10 adopted/standing threads it tracks
Events are gateway ledger records, not completed tasks, and leave out work done in T3 outside the gateway.
Events and jobs count toward the client that started the job, not necessarily the client that sent a later follow-up or answer.
Grok Bot is every bot on the shared Grok Bot connector; individual bots can't be split out.
Minions/Botons is another gateway client, used in the Minions projects since November 5. Botons is the product being built
there, not a separate client in the data.
Adopted/standing jobs are existing threads the gateway tracks rather than launched; outer-loop systems can drive them too, so
87% (the two named buckets) is not an exhaustive measure.
Other/test is early pilots, QA and a few one-offs.
Snapshot: Nov 12, 2026, about 8:50 AM PT. Gateway live since Oct 7, 2:06 PM PDT.
